description: This file defines the NotifyFilter class, which implements various ASP.NET Core filter interfaces to manage notification messages via cookies, including serialization, deserialization, and rendering of notifications within the request pipeline.

classes.name: NotifyFilter
classes.description: A sealed class implementing ASP.NET Core filter interfaces to handle notification messages, including cookie management, serialization, deserialization, and rendering within the request lifecycle.

methods.name: OnHandlerExecuting
methods.description: Handles logic before the request handler executes, retrieving notification messages from cookies.

methods.name: OnHandlerExecuted
methods.description: Handles logic after the request handler executes, updating notification messages and setting cookies if needed.

methods.name: OnResultExecutionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously processes the result, rendering notifications into the layout's message zone and managing cookies.

methods.name: SerializeNotifyEntry
methods.description: Serializes notification entries into a protected, URL-encoded string for cookie storage.

methods.name: DeserializeNotifyEntries
methods.description: Deserializes and unprotects notification entries from a cookie value.

methods.name: GetCookieOptions
methods.description: Creates cookie options with HttpOnly and Path based on the request context.

methods.name: DeleteCookies
methods.description: Deletes notification cookies from the response.
